source.quote_free_summary: Events may set a minimum age requirement for contestants; it must be published in the Event's rules.

requirement: A WSDC-bound event's organizer minimum age is organizer policy with mandatory publication; it is not a WSDC age number and never overrides the OD-02 adult-only restriction.
enforcement_point: Not built. Design only (docs/competition/governance/editions/OD-30-rulebook-editions-design.md). The OD-03/OD-18 organizer determination is the only age-division control at first activation.
interpretation_notes: EFFECTIVE DATE UNKNOWN: effective_from is a schema-required PLACEHOLDER (the date the governance registry was introduced), NOT a verified effective date; no pinned source states one (OD-30 finding F-1). No WSDC-stated minimum age.
